verdict.rationale: Cerebras' OpenAI compatibility doc says existing applications can switch by changing the API key, base URL and model ID. Marketing claims 'just two code changes', and the docs say the standard OpenAI image_url content shape is supported. Swapping the model ID is inherent to any provider switch, so the core story is delivered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a drop-in OpenAI SDK swap, and documentation of which OpenAI parameters or endpoints are unsupported.
